simple.meaning: שָׁלָה (shâlâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to draw out or off , i.e. remove (the soul by death).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Job, beginning at Job 27:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁלָה (H7953) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁלָה (shâlâh) / H7953 is traced through Job 27:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.
